goal: Respond to close review that the current Stegosaurus first image still fails the dorsal-plate recognition gate by forcing countable individual plates and a four-spike thagomizer over the relock candidate.

required: largest plates over the hips and mid-back
smaller plates toward the neck and tail base
rejectIf: tail spikes read as a second head

experiments.finding: Rejected. The plate count improves, but the old-plate cleanup becomes a broad artificial brown band along the back.
Rejected. The artificial back band is reduced, but the sky/tree repair reads as a visible triangular patch behind the plates.
Rejected as app art. It is the clearest countable row from this local route, but the plates still read as pasted rounded blocks with a visible base band.

experiments.type: SDXL refiner over v3 at low denoise
experiments.finding: Rejected. The refiner preserves the artificial plate bases, introduces lower-corner patches, and changes head/body detail without creating natural embedded Stegosaurus plates.

decision.status: rejected route with guide-first app rollback
decision.reason: The current natural-scene candidates do not satisfy the dorsal-plate reference gate. The project-owned low-body plate/thagomizer reference is more honest as the first MVP image until a Stegosaurus-specific LoRA or focused local training set can solve plate integration.
decision.nextRoute: Install/test a compatible Stegosaurus LoRA if available, or train a small stegosaur_plates_tailspikes LoRA from cleared synthetic examples whose plates already look natural before i2i/refiner.
